run_mocap_demo: run the mocap demo to playback a CMU .amc motion capture file in a humanoid simulation
parse_amc_convert: parse an AMC motion capture file and convert it to MuJoCo joint positions
render_humanoid_physics: render the humanoid physics environment from two camera angles into a video frame
set_qpos: set the humanoid joint positions from parsed mocap data using physics data qpos
create_humanoid_CMU_env: create a humanoid_CMU stand environment for motion capture playback and rendering
